user.title: Beacon
user.description: Make a key in Beacon under Settings > Account > Apps and devices, with the right to control playback (and to browse the library, for the media browser). The address is the one you open Beacon at, or for the desktop app its computer's address and port, such as http://192.168.1.20:7071.

zeroconf_confirm.title: Beacon found
zeroconf_confirm.description: {name} at {host}. Enter a key from Beacon's Settings > Account > Apps and devices, made with the right to control playback.

error.cannot_connect: Beacon is not reachable at this address, or the app is not running.
error.no_control: This key may not control playback. Make one with that right.

abort.already_configured: This Beacon is already set up.
abort.not_supported: This announcement is missing Beacon's id.

data.show_dashboard: Show the Beacon dashboard in the sidebar

data_description.show_dashboard: A ready-made dashboard for the active Beacon. To change it, copy dashboard.yaml into a dashboard of your own.

key.title: Switch {name} to a device key
key.description: Beacon replaces its Home automation key with keys made under Settings > Account > Apps and devices. Make one there with the right to control playback, and to browse the library for the media browser, then enter it here. The entities stay as they are.
